title: Preprocessing output and time bound
statement: For every finite binary word $x$, let $y$ be obtained by retaining the first two bits and then, in each successive pair, retaining both bits and continuing only when they agree; if a pair disagrees, discard it and everything after it. The preprocessing machine outputs the concatenation of $y$ and $x$ within $3|x|+5$ steps.
